name: storage-s3
title: S3 file storage
description: Direct-to-S3 uploads with presigned URLs (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO): a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, verified completion and private downloads.
docs:
1. POST /api/files/presign { fileName, contentType, size }  -> { data: { file, upload: { url, method, headers } } }
2. PUT the bytes to upload.url with upload.headers (straight from the browser)
3. POST /api/files/:id/complete  -> verifies the object in S3 and marks the file ready
Download: GET /api/files/:id/download (302 to a short-lived signed URL)
For R2/MinIO set S3_ENDPOINT. Configure CORS on the bucket to allow PUT from your frontend.
